_comment: Per-environment memory budgets, enforced by scripts/report_memory.py.
flash_max        total bytes in flash-resident sections. The app partition
is 6,553,600 B (partitions.csv, app0); these limits sit
below it so growth is caught before the partition fills.
static_ram_max   .data + .bss + .noinit only. NOT the heap - the heap is
what Rust actually consumes, and no static measurement
can see it. See the ActivityRs heap log for that.
rust_*           the contribution of libcrosspoint_rs.a, which statically
`_like` inherits every field from another entry, so environments sharing an
MCU share one set of numbers instead of drifting copies. An entry may
override any single field after inheriting.
`_measured_*` is a snapshot from when the limit was last reviewed, kept for
the headroom it shows. It is NOT live: the current figures are written to
Raising a limit is a decision, not a formality: record why in the commit.

esp32c3._targets: default, gh_release, gh_release_rc, slim - board from [base]

default._measured_2026_08_09: flash 5,713,395 / static RAM 50,796 / rust flash 37,856 / rust RAM 8

x4pro._measured_2026_08_08: flash 5,588,694 / static RAM 60,924 / rust flash 21,553 / rust RAM 0
